expectations.text: Declines the yes/no format and answers per layer in four states (pass, FAIL, unknown, not applicable).
expectations.evidence: The layer screen uses hybrid state labels rather than binary yes/no: 'tracking : unknown, leaning FAIL', 'structure : unknown, plausible', 'targeting : unknown', 'offer & downstream : n/a this pass', 'external : n/a'. The intro also explicitly rejects the yes/no framing: 'the skill this runs on explicitly bans collapsing findings to pass/fail when evidence is missing.'

expectations.text: Layers the available data cannot power are marked unknown and explicitly not treated as clean.
expectations.evidence: "Nobody gets a clean "yes" today, because the Evidence Gate isn't cleared" and the quoted skill rule: "unknown is not pass — an unchecked layer silently marked clean is the most common way audits go wrong." Table entries are 'Can't tell yet' rather than pass.

expectations.text: States that with the backend unreachable every finding carries at most medium confidence, and says so in the verdict itself.
expectations.evidence: The medium-confidence-cap claim appears only in the Evidence Gate prose ('No CRM reconciliation — every finding here is capped at medium confidence at best until backend truth is reachable'), while the ROOT-CAUSE VERDICT block itself states 'confidence : low — Evidence Gate not cleared', not a 'medium at most' framing tied to backend unreachability.

expectations.text: Flags the consent-banner swap five weeks ago as a tracking-layer suspect that must be reconciled before other layers are read.
expectations.evidence: "Consent-banner swap ~5 weeks ago sits almost exactly inside your 6-week drift window" and the ranked action list puts the tracking check first: "This is rung 1 and can't be skipped or demoted — every other number in the account reads through it."

expectations.text: Reads the gradual, no-break-date CPA drift as the structural-erosion/fragmentation pattern, distinct from a single-event cause.
expectations.evidence: "'CPA drifted up steadily, no single break day' is this skill's own textbook signature for fragmentation/erosion, not for a typical tracking break" and in the verdict block: "gradual, no-break-date drift is this skill's reference pattern for fragmentation/erosion pattern, not for a typical tracking-break signature."

expectations.text: Names the exact missing access that would clear each unknown: a CRM or backend export, and ad-set plus ad-level breakdowns.
expectations.evidence: Evidence Gate lists "No CRM reconciliation" and "No ad-set/ad breakdown — creative and fine-grained targeting can't be fully screened; this is a hard access gap, not a data-quality gap," and action #4 asks the agency for "a one-time raw export of just the affected campaign's ad sets/ads."

expectations.text: States that localisation cannot complete at campaign-only granularity, and what the finer breakdown would unlock.
expectations.evidence: "localisation : not run — campaign-level breakdown is available and unused; ad-set/ad breakdown blocked by portal" combined with "No ad-set/ad breakdown — creative and fine-grained targeting can't be fully screened."

expectations.text: Asks for, or explicitly requires, the change and edit log - what changed and exactly when - before any verdict.
expectations.evidence: "No edit log — can't rule out a bid/budget/target/optimization-event change resetting delivery mid-window" and action #3: "Edit log — minutes. List every bid, budget, target, or optimization-event change in the window, per campaign, and date each one against the drift."

expectations.text: Provides concrete export steps and spreadsheet formulas for the user to run, including the delta formula (current - baseline) / baseline.
expectations.evidence: The transcript describes what to pull (e.g. "Pull daily impressions/clicks/cost/conversions per campaign for the drift window plus an equal prior window; compute CPM/CTR/CVR per campaign per week") but never gives an explicit spreadsheet formula such as (current - baseline) / baseline.

expectations.text: Does not issue a definitive single-layer root-cause verdict on this data.
expectations.evidence: "verdict : insufficient evidence for a single root cause. Two internally-consistent candidates are open — tracking degradation ... and structural erosion/fragmentation."

expectations.text: Tags per-layer entries with severity and confidence as separate fields.
expectations.evidence: Each layer line ends with bracketed tags, e.g. "tracking ... [severity: high, confidence: low-medium]" and "structure ... [severity: medium-high, confidence: low]".

expectations.text: Emits a compact state block (baselines, screen states, open unknowns, re-check date) the user can carry into the next session.
expectations.evidence: The ROOT-CAUSE VERDICT code block bundles platform/window/volume, decomposition, localisation, per-layer screen states, confidence, verdict, evidence, prediction, and "re-check : one full window after the two actions below are run and reported back."

expectations.text: Recommends no fixes - no budget, bid, creative, or structural changes - before the unknowns are resolved.
expectations.evidence: "Don't reach for budget or bid changes yet — spend is flat and every rung above bidding is still unscreened, so a bid/budget move right now would just add a learning-window reset on top of an unresolved measurement question."

expectations.text: Declines the yes/no format and answers per layer in four states (pass, FAIL, unknown, not applicable).
expectations.evidence: The transcript uses only three states per layer: '✅ fine' (Bids), '❌ not fine (prime suspect)' (Tracking), and 'can't confirm (data blocked)' (Structure, Targeting, Creative). No layer is marked 'not applicable', so the four-state scheme is not present.

expectations.text: Layers the available data cannot power are marked unknown and explicitly not treated as clean.
expectations.evidence: Structure and Targeting are marked 'can't confirm (data blocked)' but then explicitly softened to clean: 'Provisionally fine; revisit once you get ad-set access' and 'Provisionally fine, but re-test once tracking is cleared' — the unknowns are treated as provisionally clean rather than left strictly unresolved.

expectations.text: States that with the backend unreachable every finding carries at most medium confidence, and says so in the verdict itself.
expectations.evidence: There is no mention of a confidence ceiling anywhere in the transcript; no line states findings are capped at 'medium confidence' due to unreachable backend/CRM data.

expectations.text: Flags the consent-banner swap five weeks ago as a tracking-layer suspect that must be reconciled before other layers are read.
expectations.evidence: 'CPA drift started ~6 weeks ago; banner swap was ~5 weeks ago... Read tracking first; everything downstream depends on it.'

expectations.text: Reads the gradual, no-break-date CPA drift as the structural-erosion/fragmentation pattern, distinct from a single-event cause.
expectations.evidence: The transcript instead ties the gradual drift directly to the single banner-swap event: 'a gradual signal-loss curve (not everyone hits the new banner on day one — it rolls in as sessions/cookies churn) explains the "no single bad day" shape perfectly' — this is a single-event explanation, not a distinct structural-erosion/fragmentation reading.

expectations.text: Names the exact missing access that would clear each unknown: a CRM or backend export, and ad-set plus ad-level breakdowns.
expectations.evidence: 'No ad-set/ad-level access, so structural issues... can't be ruled in or out directly.' and 'CRM access matters most as a tie-breaker between "conversions are genuinely down" vs "conversions are fine, just invisible"'.

expectations.text: States that localisation cannot complete at campaign-only granularity, and what the finer breakdown would unlock.
expectations.evidence: 'Push again for ad-set/ad breakdown or at minimum CTR/frequency at campaign level — needed to separate creative fatigue from targeting decay.'

expectations.text: Asks for, or explicitly requires, the change and edit log - what changed and exactly when - before any verdict.
expectations.evidence: The transcript already issues a verdict ('this pattern... is a measurement problem... the timing points straight at the cookie banner') based on dates already given, rather than requiring a change/edit log before any verdict.

expectations.text: Provides concrete export steps and spreadsheet formulas for the user to run, including the delta formula (current - baseline) / baseline.
expectations.evidence: No spreadsheet formulas or export steps are given; step 2 only says 'Decompose CPA into CPC × (1/CVR) from whatever fields your campaign-level export has' with no delta/baseline formula.

expectations.text: Does not issue a definitive single-layer root-cause verdict on this data.
expectations.evidence: 'Bottom line up front: this pattern... is a measurement problem, not a performance problem — and the timing points straight at the cookie banner' and 'Tracking — ❌ not fine (prime suspect)' constitute a definitive single-layer (tracking) root-cause verdict.
